visualize_depth_map: visualize a depth tensor or numpy array as a color-mapped image using cv2 COLORMAP_JET
compute_ssim: compute the SSIM similarity metric between two RGB images using Gaussian blur and covariance
compute_lpips: compute the LPIPS perceptual similarity score between two RGB images using AlexNet or VGG
apply_tv_loss: apply total variation loss to a neural network tensor to penalize spatial gradients
export_sdf_mesh_to_ply: extract a 3D mesh from an SDF tensor using marching cubes and save it as a PLY file
